besluite.rede: Placing the means phrase after the verb cluster is natural spoken Afrikaans; the reorder is a lateral move.
'Daarin le die energie gestoor' reads naturally and links to the previous sentence; the passive only reads differently.

besluite.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses joined by 'en'
besluite.rede: Both halves have their own subject and verb, so the AWS 2017 comma before 'en' is required.
'en weer terug' is an idiomatic Afrikaans expression, not a fault; dropping 'weer' is lateral.

besluite.fout: no comma before the concessive al-clause, inconsistent with the same construction later in the lesson
besluite.rede: The comma separates main and subordinate clause, aids a first reading and matches 'oop, al raak hulle'.

besluite.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses joined by 'en'
besluite.rede: 'Dit is ...' and 'die lampie brand' each have their own subject and verb, so the comma is required.

besluite.fout: 'die lampie is dood' is colloquial and missing the AWS comma
besluite.rede: 'brand nie' is standard, mirrors the closed case exactly, keeps the meaning and adds the required comma.
'aan mekaar raak' is correct Afrikaans and 'wegbeweeg' is clear in context; the proposal only lengthens the sentence.

besluite.fout: 'om te teken as prente' can be misread as 'draw as pictures' and compares an action with a thing
besluite.rede: Completing the comparison with 'as om prente ... te maak' removes the stumble without changing what is compared.

besluite.fout: 'regte' beside 'reguit lyne met hoeke' can read as 'straight' or evoke 'regte hoeke'
besluite.rede: 'werklike' says 'the actual wires' unambiguously, with the same meaning.
'met die een langer as die ander' is a natural Afrikaans construction; the relative clause is longer and no clearer in a list item.

besluite.fout: compound written with an unneeded hyphen
besluite.rede: Afrikaans writes the compound 'selsimbole' as one word; there is no vowel clash to justify the hyphen.
'laat 'n gaping' is the standard Afrikaans expression and keeps the meaning.
